$schema-note: Curated per-component prose for the documentation contract (#221) and the public component reference (WBS-G061 B1). Machine facts (imports, exports, deps, examples, and every *Props field/type/default) are DERIVED — the former by scripts/generate-component-reference.mjs, the latter by scripts/component-props-lib.mjs from packages/ui/src; this file holds only the human-authored fields the contracts require. Every public component MUST have a non-empty `purpose` and a non-empty `behavior` (the controlled/uncontrolled + callback + disabled/failure-mode contract, condensed from docs/components.md's "Key contract" column or, where that has nothing for the family, from the component source directly); `limitations` and `notes` are optional. `pnpm docs:contract:check` and `node scripts/public-component-reference.mjs --check` fail if an entry is missing, extra, or missing `behavior`.

accordion.purpose: Single-value controlled/uncontrolled disclosure group where one item expands at a time.
accordion.behavior: Single-value controlled (`value`/`onValueChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`) disclosure coordination shared by every `AccordionItem`; a disabled item's trigger stays non-interactive and cannot expand, and only the active item's `AccordionContent` mounts.

alert-banner.purpose: Inline semantic status callout with live-region announcement for feedback that stays on screen.
alert-banner.behavior: Stateless inline callout with no open/close or controlled prop; it live-announces (Android live-region, iOS `AccessibilityInfo`) whenever mounted with new content, with an optional explicit announcement override for complex children.

alert-dialog.purpose: Confirmation/destructive modal built on the Dialog kernel; only explicit Cancel/Action closes it.
alert-dialog.behavior: Confirmation/destructive modal sharing Dialog's controlled (`open`+`onOpenChange`, both required together) or uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) contract; unlike Dialog it never closes from a backdrop press or Escape — only an explicit `AlertDialogCancel`/`AlertDialogAction` closes it.
alert-dialog.limitations: Never dismisses from backdrop press or Escape; not a general-purpose modal (use Dialog).

app-header.purpose: Title/description/leading/trailing screen-header composition; owns no navigation library.
app-header.behavior: Stateless title/description/leading/trailing composition with no controlled props or callbacks; a primitive title receives header accessibility semantics automatically, while a complex title node owns its own semantics.

avatar.purpose: Image-with-fallback identity surface with size variants and source-keyed failure reset.
avatar.behavior: Stateless image-with-fallback: an image load failure resets to the fallback, and the reset is keyed to the semantic image source content (not object identity), so re-supplying an already-failed source shows the fallback again immediately.

badge.purpose: Compact semantic status label with paired foreground/background tokens.
badge.behavior: Stateless semantic status label; `variant` selects the paired foreground/background token pair, with no controlled/open state or callbacks.

bottom-action-bar.purpose: Bottom-anchored primary-action surface; safe-area ownership stays with the app shell.
bottom-action-bar.behavior: Stateless bottom-anchored action surface with no controlled props; it adds no system-inset padding itself, so the app shell must wrap it with `SafeArea` or safe-area utilities.
bottom-action-bar.limitations: Does not add system insets itself; wrap with SafeArea or safe-area utilities.

box.purpose: Thin View primitive with no design assumptions, for ad-hoc layout.
box.behavior: Stateless layout primitive — a thin `View` with no controlled props, callbacks, or design assumptions.

breadcrumb.purpose: Router-neutral breadcrumb trail with decorative separators hidden from accessibility.
breadcrumb.behavior: Stateless router-neutral trail; separators between `BreadcrumbItem`s are decorative and hidden from accessibility, `BreadcrumbItem` renders link semantics for navigable ancestors and non-interactive current-location semantics for the active item, and supplied child keys are preserved when separators are composed in.

button.purpose: Accessible pressable with variant/size/loading/disabled states and an optional label primitive.
button.behavior: Stateless pressable driven entirely by props (`variant`/`size`/`loading`/`disabled`); `disabled` or `loading` both block press handling and mark the accessibility disabled state, and `loading` swaps in a spinner without changing the button's footprint.

calendar.purpose: Month-grid date-selection surface; owns no field, popover, or input chrome.
calendar.behavior: Controlled month-grid date selection on `value`/`onValueChange` (`CalendarDate | null`); `isDateDisabled` fails a date safe as unselectable, and it owns no field, popover, or input chrome of its own.

card.purpose: Elevated/outlined surface with variant and spacing contract.
card.behavior: Stateless elevated/outlined surface driven by a `variant` and spacing prop; no controlled state or callbacks.

checkbox.purpose: Controlled boolean/indeterminate checkbox; enabled usage without onCheckedChange warns in development.
checkbox.behavior: Controlled boolean/indeterminate `checked`/`onCheckedChange` checkbox; enabling it without `onCheckedChange` warns in development instead of silently doing nothing, and `disabled` blocks both press handling and the accessibility toggle action.

chip.purpose: Standalone toggle or value-scoped group item with button/radio/checkbox semantics.
chip.behavior: Standalone toggle (`pressed`/`onPressedChange`) or, nested in `ChipGroup`, a value-scoped selection item; a grouped `Chip` rendered without a `value` fails safe as disabled and warns in development, and `ChipGroup` supports controlled/uncontrolled single- or multiple-selection.

collapsible.purpose: Controlled/uncontrolled single-region disclosure with content mounted only while open.
collapsible.behavior: Controlled (`open`/`onOpenChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) single-region disclosure; `CollapsibleContent` mounts only while open, so its children never render (or run effects) while collapsed.

date-picker.purpose: Native system date-picker field backed by @react-native-community/datetimepicker.
date-picker.behavior: Controlled `value`/`onValueChange` (`CalendarDate | null`) field wrapping the native system date picker; `disabled` blocks opening the picker, and `clearable` opts in an explicit clear affordance rather than allowing an implicit empty selection.
date-picker.notes: Platform-split: resolves date-picker.native.tsx / date-picker.web.tsx at build time.

date-time-picker.purpose: Native combined date-and-time picker field backed by @react-native-community/datetimepicker.
date-time-picker.behavior: Controlled `value`/`onValueChange` (`{ date, time } | null`) field combining date and time entry through the native system pickers; `disabled` blocks opening either sub-picker.
date-time-picker.notes: Platform-split module; segmented date/time entry on native.

description-list.purpose: Read-only grouped label/value metadata composition with no data-state ownership.
description-list.behavior: Stateless read-only grouped label/value composition; it owns no data-state, loading, or formatting behavior — callers pass already-resolved values.

dialog.purpose: Controlled/uncontrolled modal backed by React Native core Modal, with a real Web focus trap and Escape dismissal.
dialog.behavior: Controlled (`open`+`onOpenChange`, `defaultOpen` forbidden) or uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`, `open` forbidden) modal state; supplying `open` without `onOpenChange` warns in development and falls back to dismissable behavior. Backdrop press, Web Escape, and Android hardware back all route through one close policy, while `dismissOnRequestClose={false}`/`dismissOnEscape={false}` opt individual channels out.

dropdown-menu.purpose: Non-modal action menu on the shared anchored-overlay runtime, with items, checkbox items, and radio groups.
dropdown-menu.behavior: Controlled/uncontrolled (`open`/`onOpenChange`/`defaultOpen`) non-modal menu; `DropdownMenuItem`'s `onSelect` closes the menu by default after the handler runs, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` stays open by default, and `DropdownMenuRadioGroup` fails safe by disabling every item that shares a duplicate value.

field.purpose: Label/description/error composition for text-entry controls; wires accessible label and required relationships to text inputs only.
field.behavior: Stateless label/description/error composition; it wires accessible label/required/error relationships only to a wrapped text-entry control (`Input`/`Textarea`) — never to checkbox/radio/switch, which label themselves explicitly.
field.limitations: Checkbox/radio/switch labelling stays explicit at the control/group level.

form-group.purpose: Structural legend/description/error grouping for related controls without becoming one accessible parent element.
form-group.behavior: Structural legend/description/error/disabled grouping; it stays `accessible={false}` (there is no generic native `fieldset` role) and never mutates descendant state directly — only semantic-aware children such as `RadioGroup` opt into consuming its context.

form-message.purpose: Destructive form feedback (with muted HelperText variant) using polite live-region semantics.
form-message.behavior: Stateless destructive form-feedback text with polite live-region semantics by default; it renders the muted `HelperText` variant when not carrying an active error.

icon-button.purpose: 44px icon-only action; an accessible label is required.
icon-button.behavior: Stateless 44px icon-only pressable sharing Button's `disabled`/`loading` semantics; an accessible label (`accessibilityLabel`) is required because there is no visible text to derive one from.

input.purpose: Single-line text input with semantic focus/invalid/disabled states and Field-provided accessibility.
input.behavior: Uncontrolled-by-default text field (standard React Native `value`/`onChangeText`); `invalid`/`disabled`/focus state drive semantic styling, while label/required/error metadata come from a wrapping `Field`, not from `Input` itself.

keyboard-aware-screen.purpose: Scrollable form-screen shell with bounded width, explicit safe-area ownership, and platform keyboard handling.
keyboard-aware-screen.behavior: Stateless scrollable form-screen shell; it owns explicit safe-area edges and platform keyboard avoidance/dismissal defaults, but no routing, form state, validation, auth, or persistence — those stay entirely with the caller.
keyboard-aware-screen.limitations: Owns no routing, form state, validation, auth, or persistence.

label.purpose: Semantic form/control label with accessible required-state wording and optional nativeID linkage.
label.behavior: Stateless form/control label; `required` renders accessible required-state wording, and `nativeID` links it to a control only when explicitly supplied.

link.purpose: Link semantics over Pressable; owns no navigation library or routing behavior.
link.behavior: Stateless link semantics layered on `Pressable`; `disabled` blocks press handling and marks the accessibility disabled state, and it owns no navigation/routing library integration.

list-group.purpose: Bordered grouped-row surface with list container semantics and an aligned header.
list-group.behavior: Stateless bordered grouped-row surface with list container semantics; it does not own row press/selection state — that stays with each `ListItem`.

list-item.purpose: Grouped row (with a settings-row specialization) that synthesizes accessible names from primitive content when interactive.
list-item.behavior: Press behavior is opt-in (`onPress` makes the row interactive); an interactive row without an explicit `accessibilityLabel` synthesizes one from its primitive title/description/trailing content, while non-interactive rows never hide complex descendant content.

metadata-row.behavior: Stateless read-only label/value row primitive with no data-state or formatting ownership.

otp-input.purpose: Controlled/uncontrolled one-time-code input with numeric normalization and per-value completion callbacks.
otp-input.behavior: Controlled/uncontrolled one-time-code input; entered text is normalized to digits, and the completion callback fires exactly once per completed value — it does not re-fire on further keystrokes while already complete, only after the value becomes incomplete again.

pagination.purpose: Controlled page/page-count context with normalized boundaries and type-enforced page/prev/next items.
pagination.behavior: Controlled `page`/`onPageChange` context shared with every `PaginationItem`; page boundaries are normalized (out-of-range requests are clamped), and a malformed runtime page item (e.g. a `type="page"` item with no `page` number) fails safe as disabled.

password-input.purpose: Password field with visibility toggle and safe keyboard/autofill defaults; caller overrides remain authoritative.
password-input.behavior: Uncontrolled-by-default text field (same contract as `Input`) with a visibility-toggle affordance; toggling visibility never changes the caller-owned `secureTextEntry`/autofill overrides, which remain authoritative.

popover.purpose: Non-modal anchored surface on the shared overlay runtime with flip/shift/collision and safe-area policy.
popover.behavior: Controlled (`open`+`onOpenChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) non-modal anchored surface reusing the shared `BeeUIProvider` overlay runtime; among nested overlays, only the topmost open popover dismisses on an outside press or Escape.

progress.purpose: Clamped determinate progress bar with native progressbar semantics.
progress.behavior: Stateless clamped determinate progress bar; `value` is clamped to its `min`/`max` range and exposes native progressbar semantics — there is no indeterminate mode.

radio.purpose: Controlled radio item and RadioGroup coordinator with native radiogroup semantics.
radio.behavior: Standalone `Radio` supports both selection and deselection through `onCheckedChange`; grouped through `RadioGroup` (`value`/`onValueChange` controlled, or `defaultValue` uncontrolled) radios become mutually exclusive and can no longer deselect. Enabled usage without the matching callback warns in development.

safe-area.purpose: BeeUIProvider application root plus an explicit SafeArea surface with caller-owned edge selection.
safe-area.behavior: `BeeUIProvider` (the application root) supplies safe-area measurement, the Toast runtime/viewport, and the shared anchored-overlay runtime to every descendant; `SafeArea` itself is a stateless surface with caller-owned `edges` selection — BeeUI never adds system insets to other components implicitly.
safe-area.notes: BeeUIProvider supplies safe-area measurement, the Toast runtime/viewport, and the shared anchored-overlay runtime.

screen.purpose: Base application surface with semantic background and optional spacing; owns no safe-area or scroll behavior.
screen.behavior: Stateless base application surface with a semantic background and optional spacing prop; it owns no safe-area or scroll behavior itself.

search-input.purpose: Search-keyboard input layered on Input; clearing a non-empty query emits one onSearch('') reset.
search-input.behavior: Uncontrolled-by-default search-keyboard field layered on `Input`; clearing a previously non-empty query emits exactly one `onSearch('')` reset call, not one per keystroke of the clear action.

section.behavior: Stateless title/description/action/content composition for screen sections; no controlled state or callbacks.

segmented-control.purpose: Compact mutually-exclusive selection surface with radiogroup semantics.
segmented-control.behavior: Controlled (`value`/`onValueChange`) mutually exclusive selection with `radiogroup` semantics; enabled usage without `onValueChange` warns in development, and a disabled segment cannot be selected.

select.purpose: Persistent single string-value selection with anchored option surface and listbox semantics on Web.
select.behavior: Controlled (`value`/`onValueChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`) persistent single-value selection, independent of the anchored `open`/`onOpenChange`/`defaultOpen` presentation state; a duplicate `SelectItem` value disables every item sharing it and warns in development, and removing the selected option does not synthesize a value change — `SelectValue` falls back to its placeholder until a matching item returns.

separator.purpose: Decorative-by-default divider (semantic when requested); vertical orientation stretches across the cross axis.
separator.behavior: Stateless decorative-by-default divider; `decorative={false}` makes it semantic, and a vertical orientation stretches across the parent's cross axis instead of relying on a percentage height.

sheet.purpose: Gesture-driven bottom sheet with detents on the shared overlay runtime.
sheet.behavior: Controlled (`open`+`onOpenChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) gesture-driven bottom sheet on the shared overlay runtime; dismissal (backdrop press, swipe, Web Escape, Android hardware back) routes through the same `dismissOnRequestClose`/`onRequestClose` contract Dialog uses.
sheet.notes: Native gesture engine uses @gorhom/bottom-sheet + reanimated/gesture-handler; platform-split module.

skeleton.behavior: Stateless decorative static loading placeholder; it is hidden from the accessibility tree and carries no loading-state callbacks.

spinner.purpose: Native activity indicator with semantic tone mapping.
spinner.behavior: Stateless native activity indicator with semantic tone mapping; no controlled props.

stack.purpose: Typed direction/gap/alignment/wrap layout over View, with HStack/VStack specializations.
stack.behavior: Stateless typed direction/gap/alignment/wrap layout over `View`; `HStack` defaults cross-axis alignment to center (still overridable) and `VStack` is the vertical specialization — no controlled state.

stat.purpose: Layout-only metric composition (label/value/help text) with no formatting or state ownership.
stat.behavior: Stateless layout-only metric composition (`StatLabel`/`StatValue`/`StatHelpText`); it owns no number formatting or state.

state-message.purpose: Empty-state and error-state (with retry) composition for zero/failure surfaces.
state-message.behavior: Stateless empty-state (`EmptyState`) and error-state (`ErrorState`, with an optional retry action) composition for zero/failure surfaces; the caller owns the retry handler and any loading state around it.

stepper.purpose: Controlled current-step context with finite normalization and duplicate-step fail-safe; owns no workflow state.
stepper.behavior: Controlled `currentStep` context shared with every `StepperItem`; step values are normalized to a finite range, and a `StepperItem` sharing a duplicate normalized step value fails safe as disabled — it owns no application workflow state.

switch.purpose: Controlled native switch with semantic track/thumb colors; enabled usage without onValueChange warns in development.
switch.behavior: Controlled native `Switch` (`value`/`onValueChange`); enabled usage without `onValueChange` warns in development instead of silently doing nothing.

table.purpose: Semantic data-table primitives that render real table/th scope/aria-sort semantics on Web.
table.behavior: Composable primitive family with no owned fetching, sort/filter/selection state, or spreadsheet-style cell navigation. `TableHead`'s `sortDirection`/`onSortChange` pair is fully caller-controlled (the presence of `sortDirection` is what marks a column sortable); `TableRow`'s `selected` is a caller-owned boolean reflected only visually/for accessibility. `layout` (`'scroll'` default, or `'stacked'`) is an explicit caller choice — Table never measures viewport width itself.
table.notes: Platform-split; see docs/data-typography.md for data-cell typography.

tabs.purpose: Controlled tab set sharing state across list/triggers/content; inactive panels are not mounted.
tabs.behavior: Controlled (`value`/`onValueChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`) tab state shared across `TabsList`/`TabsTrigger`/`TabsContent`; enabled usage without `onValueChange` warns in development, and an inactive `TabsContent` panel is not mounted.

text.purpose: Semantic typography primitive with type/tone variants that honors OS/browser font scaling.
text.behavior: Stateless semantic typography primitive; `type`/`tone` variants apply typed styling, and text always honors OS/browser font scaling — BeeUI never sets `allowFontScaling={false}`.

textarea.purpose: Multiline text input using the same semantic contract as Input.
textarea.behavior: Uncontrolled-by-default multiline text field sharing `Input`'s focus/invalid/disabled semantic contract.

theme-scope.purpose: BeeThemeScope subtree boundary that applies a scoped theme override to its descendants.
theme-scope.behavior: Stateless `BeeThemeScope` subtree boundary; it applies a scoped theme override to descendants with no controlled props of its own — precedence rules are documented in `docs/theme-scope.md`.
theme-scope.notes: See docs/theme-scope.md for the scoping and precedence rules.

timeline.purpose: Read-only ordered history composition with semantic marker states; owns no workflow state.
timeline.behavior: Stateless read-only ordered history composition; terminal connector placement is derived automatically from the rendered `TimelineItem` children, and supplied child keys are preserved — it owns no workflow state.

toast.purpose: Provider-scoped toast runtime exposed via useToast (show/dismiss/dismissAll) with FIFO queueing and safe-area-aware stacking.
toast.behavior: Provider-scoped imperative API (`useToast().show`/`dismiss`/`dismissAll`) rather than a controlled component; toasts queue FIFO with at most three visible at once, an explicit persistent mode opts a toast out of auto-dismiss, and action-triggered dismissal is deterministic (never racing the auto-dismiss timer).
toast.limitations: No Modal/anchored geometry and no arbitrary ReactNode transport; descriptors only.

tooltip.purpose: Non-interactive contextual annotation (ADR-005): a hover/focus delay state machine plus an anchored, non-focusable bubble.
tooltip.behavior: Controlled (`open`+`onOpenChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) non-interactive contextual annotation; on hover it opens after `openDelay` (default 500ms) and closes after `closeDelay` (default 300ms), but focus always opens immediately and blur always closes immediately regardless of those delays. `TooltipTrigger` never toggles open state on press.
tooltip.limitations: Never a press target and never interactive content; use Popover for interactive overlays.

use-bee-token.purpose: Read resolved design-token values at runtime via useBeeToken (hook) and getBeeToken (imperative).
use-bee-token.behavior: Stateless read-only accessors — `useBeeToken` (hook) and `getBeeToken` (imperative) — for resolved design-token values at runtime; neither writes tokens or holds component state.

visually-hidden.purpose: Keeps non-interactive assistive content in the accessibility tree while removing it from visual layout.
visually-hidden.behavior: Stateless wrapper that keeps non-interactive content in the accessibility tree while removing it from visual layout; it must never be used as a substitute for labelling an interactive control.
visually-hidden.limitations: Never a substitute for labelling an interactive control.
